reminders.prompt.flag: True while the reminders plugin is running (false when it's disabled in config plugins.disabled or failed to load): wraps the paragraphs about reminders
reminders.prompt.title: Reminders (reminders plugin)
reminders.prompt.description: How the Secretary creates, changes and cancels reminders with {tool} and friends; this part is left out of the Secretary's prompt when the reminders plugin is disabled
reminders.plugin.title: Reminders
reminders.plugin.summary: Gives you a heads-up at a set time or when something happens — simple reminders, no agent work
reminders.plugin.purge.reminders: All reminders (on the board and calendar) with every edit and firing record
reminders.plugin.purge.cards: Every version of reminder cards (in chats and the inbox)
reminders.plugin.keep.secretary: What the chat says about reminders (what you told it, its replies)
reminders.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (goes away as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
reminders.alreadyFired: Reminder {id} “{text}” has already gone off. Create a new one to be reminded again
reminders.missed.title: Missed reminder: {text}
reminders.missed.body: The reminder for {when} didn't go off on time (the daemon wasn't running then). It's {late} late, so it's here instead.
reminders.due.title: Reminder: {text}
reminders.schedule.repeatNoDay: Repeating reminders don't take at, date, weekday, inDays or inMinutes: give only the time (time) and the repeat rule (repeat)
reminders.schedule.repeatNeedTime: Repeating reminders need a time (time, HH:mm)
reminders.schedule.oneDaySpec: Give only one of at, date, weekday, inDays, inMinutes
reminders.schedule.atNoTime: With at (date and time together), don't also give time
reminders.schedule.inMinutesNoTime: With inMinutes, don't also give time
reminders.schedule.badInMinutes: inMinutes must be a positive integer (minutes from now), got {value}
reminders.schedule.onceNeedTime: One-time reminders need a time (time, HH:mm), or a date and time with at, or minutes from now with inMinutes
reminders.schedule.badInDays: inDays must be an integer of at least 0 (0 is today, 1 is tomorrow), got {value}
reminders.schedule.badWeekday: weekday must be 0–6 (0 is Sunday), got {value}
reminders.schedule.passed: That time has already passed: {at} (it's {now} now)
reminders.schedule.badDate: Invalid date: {value} (use YYYY-MM-DD, or just MM-DD)
reminders.schedule.passedSchedule: That time has already passed (or is written wrong): {schedule} (it's {now} now)
reminders.noSuchPending: No reminder with ID {id}. Pending reminders: {list}
reminders.noSuchNone: No reminder with ID {id}. There are no pending reminders
reminders.due.bodyLate: Reminder for {when}, {late} late (the daemon wasn't running then).
reminders.scheduleOrEvent: A reminder needs either a time (schedule) or an event (event), not both
reminders.noEventSources: Event reminders aren't connected to event sources yet
reminders.notEnded: Reminder {id} “{text}” hasn’t ended yet (pending). Cancel it before archiving
reminders.noSuchArchivable: No reminder with ID {id}. Reminders you can archive (one-time reminders that went off, cancelled ones): {list}
reminders.noSuchArchivableNone: No reminder with ID {id}. There are no reminders to archive (only one-time reminders that went off and cancelled ones can be archived)
reminders.noSuchAny: No reminder with ID {id}. Current reminders: {list}
reminders.noSuchAnyNone: No reminder with ID {id}. There are no reminders
reminders.actionInternal: Something went wrong inside. It wasn’t done
reminders.deleteAction.title: Delete reminder
reminders.deleteAction.done: Deleted reminder {id} “{text}”. It no longer appears on the board, calendar or inbox
